veranderings.voor: sien of vashou of in jou hand
veranderings.na: sien, vashou of in jou hand
veranderings.rede: A list of three verbs takes commas rather than a repeated 'of', as elsewhere in the lesson.

veranderings.voor: Daar was niks warms in jou hande nie en geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie.
veranderings.na: Daar was niks warms in jou hande nie, en daar was geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie.
veranderings.rede: The second half lacks its own verb and reads elliptically; giving it 'daar was' makes two clear clauses, joined with the AWS comma.

veranderings.voor: Die brandstof vir vliegtuie kom daaruit en so ook die was van baie kerse.
veranderings.na: Die brandstof vir vliegtuie en die was van baie kerse kom ook daaruit.
veranderings.rede: The tacked-on 'en so ook' is wooden for Grade 4; one subject with one verb says the same thing more plainly.

veranderings.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
veranderings.na: Elektrisiteit is die manier waarop die energie
veranderings.rede: 'X is hoe ...' calques English 'X is how ...'; 'die manier waarop' is the natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's own glossary wording.

vlae.teks: Niemand kan energie sien of vashou of in jou hand uitgooi nie.
vlae.rede: 'Niemand' paired with 'jou hand' mixes persons; not changed because the previous round deliberately chose 'jou hand'.
